purpose: Depict an action occurring immediately when another happens.
keywords: V dictionary / た + が早いか + past event
The instant the bell rang, the cat ran away.
He fell asleep the instant he sat down.
As soon as the doors opened, customers poured in.
formation: V dictionary / た + が早いか + past event
restrictions: Usually observed events, often with the same actor.
mistake: Avoid using it to issue an instruction or state a future intention.
